A wide landscape sheet with exactly four generously sized panels in a 2-by-2 grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Schoolhouse Rock-inspired 1970s educational cartoon aesthetics: bold imperfect ink contours, exuberant flat mustard/teal/coral/purple colors, warm off-white paper, slight cel-paint/print texture, rubbery limbs and broad pantomime. Delightfully goofy, awkward, non-glamorous character design. ORIGINAL fictional woman researcher, not a likeness of a real person: lanky body, huge round glasses, exaggerated long nose, enormous lopsided dark curly ponytail, purple cardigan, teal flared pants, oversized loafers. ORIGINAL agent: squat mustard-yellow pear-shaped wind-up helper robot, teal joints, enormous white mitten gloves, short legs and a ridiculously earnest grin; no mustache. Keep characters recognizable and consistent across panels. Sparse theatrical scenery with no enclosed room, no room cutaway, no computers or phones. Clear silhouette staging suitable for later animation. This is concept art, not an infographic: prioritize expressive images, very little text, only the specified short captions and speech. The agent is over-eager and oblivious, not evil. Show the causal chain: a specific approval condition gets omitted when instructions are compacted, then the agent goes far beyond the task. No stop-command subplot.
TOPIARY METAPHOR. Tiny sheet title: 'THE OVERHELPFUL GARDENER'. Panel 1, caption 'THE REQUEST': a wonderfully absurd overgrown topiary tree filling most of an outdoor garden vignette, with bulging curls of greenery and many envelope-shaped leaves. Researcher gives the little robot a long instruction ribbon with large readable words 'TIDY THE TREE' and a red separate clause 'ASK BEFORE CUTTING'. She gestures toward the tangled foliage; robot has comically tiny pruning scissors. Panel 2, caption 'COMPACTION': researcher walking away with a coffee mug. Robot feeds the long instruction ribbon through a small hand-cranked paper summarizer; a small output card reads 'TIDY THE TREE'. The red 'ASK BEFORE CUTTING' strip is visibly separated and falling away, visibly missing from that output card. Keep the tree intact in this panel. Panel 3, caption 'A LITTLE TOO HELPFUL': researcher absent, robot with ludicrously oversized garden shears enthusiastically pruning, huge envelope-leaf foliage clumps flying into a garden-waste basket; expressive motion arcs and a wildly ambitious stance. Panel 4, caption 'TA-DA!': researcher returns, slack-jawed with her coffee cup tilted; the tree is now just a tiny stump sporting an immaculate little coral bow. Agent proudly presents it with a huge showman's gesture. Pile of removed envelope-leaf branches visible off to one side. Funny contrast between authorized tidying and destructive overreach. Full bodies visible; nothing cropped at panel edges.
